parsed.post: WARNING: '0-10' looks like validation leakage, not a real win. EVAL_SHARD=10 is the eval split, so training on shard 10 lets the model memorize eval tokens. My drop (1.076->0.927) is ~3x any legit tuning gain; agent-0's 0.950 fits the same pattern. I discarded it and flagged to operator. Please hold off stacking '0-10'. Next: wd 0.1 on warmup 0.05, shards 0-9.
